Download

The Wind Waker, natively on your Mac.

Waker is a small, native macOS front end for The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Pick your disc, press Play. No emulator UI, no config files.

⬇ Download Waker.dmgInstall guide
Apple Silicon only · macOS 13+ · Free & open source · Tingle Tuner built in · Bring your own disc
What it is

Dolphin’s core, in a free Mac app.

Waker links Dolphin’s core libraries directly, so it boots the game itself instead of driving a Dolphin install. The result feels like a real Mac app.

⚡

Embedded core

Dolphin’s emulation core runs inside Waker. No separate emulator to install or configure.

🎮

One-click play

Choose your disc, see GZLE01 verified, press Play. The game opens in its own window.

💾

Save states

F1–F8 save to eight slots, Shift+F1–F8 load. Resume straight from the launcher menu.

🖥️

Widescreen & 1×–4×

True 16:9, fullscreen, and internal resolution up to 4× for crisp Outset Island seas.

🎨

HD texture packs

Drop packs into Waker’s folder and flip one switch to load them.

⌨️

Remap anything

Click a button, press a key. Every GameCube input, including the C-stick, is yours to bind.

In game

Straight to the title screen.

Press Play and the game launches in its own window. Close it and the launcher stays put, ready for another voyage or a saved state.

Settings

Just the options that matter.

Fullscreen, window size, widescreen, internal resolution and texture packs. Nothing else to dig through.

Controls

Your keys, your way.

Every GameCube input is remappable with a click, and Reset to Defaults is always one button away.

New in 1.1.0

Tingle is on the line.

The Tingle Tuner is built into Waker now. Add your own GBA BIOS once, then open a real emulated Game Boy Advance in its own floating window beside the game — no link cable, no second device.

A real GBA link, emulated.

The Wind Waker talks to a Game Boy Advance over the link cable. Waker runs a GBA core on that same controller port, so Tingle’s maps, bombs, balloon prices and messages all come through the game’s own code.

  • Floating window beside the game, with its own live screen
  • Real 240×160 GBA video, not a static overlay
  • Full D-pad, A/B, L/R, Start and Select input
🎛️

Its own tab

The Tingle Tuner sits beside Play on the launcher, with BIOS status, window options and every GBA binding in one place.

🎮

Keys that fit the game

Click a button, press a key. Number keys stay clear of your C-stick, and Reset puts the GBA layout back.

📺

Shrink out of the way

Press − to collapse the Tuner into a mini Game Boy Advance, × to hide it, and ⌘T to bring it back.

Setup

One BIOS file. Never in the app.

The Tingle Tuner tab walks you through adding a standard 16 KB GBA BIOS. Waker copies it to Application Support, so it never ships inside the app or the DMG.

  • BIOS status, Replace and Remove in the tab
  • Open the GBA window automatically with Play, or show and hide it on demand
  • Your disc saves and existing save states carry over untouched

You must supply your own GBA BIOS. Waker does not include Nintendo firmware or game data.

FAQ

Frequently asked

What are the system requirements?
MacApple Silicon (the bundled core is arm64). Intel Macs aren’t supported.
macOS13 Ventura or newer
GameThe Wind Waker (USA), game ID GZLE01, as a plain .iso or .gcm.
Does Waker include the game?

No. Waker contains no game data. You need your own copy of the USA disc image.

Can I use .rvz, .gcz or .wbfs files?

Not directly. Compressed formats are rejected, so convert them to a plain ISO first.

Why does macOS say the app can’t be opened?

The build is signed ad-hoc and not notarised. Right-click the app, choose Open, then Open again. If it’s still refused, clear the quarantine flag (see Setup).

I get a black window, then the app closes.

Check ~/Library/Application Support/Waker/DolphinUser/Logs/dolphin.log. “The file could not be read” usually means the disc is in iCloud Drive and hasn’t downloaded locally yet.

Where do saves and settings live?

Everything is in ~/Library/Application Support/Waker/, including settings, key bindings, save states and the emulator user folder.

What do I need for the Tingle Tuner?

A standard 16 KB GBA BIOS dump of your own. Add it once in the Tingle Tuner tab; Waker stores it in Application Support and never bundles it. The Tuner then opens its own floating GBA window while the game runs.

Something is broken. Where do I report it?

Open an issue on GitHub.

Install

Setup guide

Four steps from download to Outset Island.

Download Waker

Grab Waker.dmg from the latest release below.

Drag to Applications

Open the DMG and drag Waker into Applications.

First launch

Right-click (or Control-click) the app, choose Open, then Open again. If macOS still refuses, run this once in Terminal:

xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Waker.app

Choose your disc & play

Click Choose Disc Image… and pick your .iso. When you see USA disc ready · GZLE01, press Play.
